packages.title: Día view: the one «Sin hora» row fits whole at 2×, with a line under the area
brief: Round 3 (b3). UX-1639 (R2B-1 from P202, S1), new; UX-1633 (S2) rides along so the reviewer re-checks it on the changed code (review B found it fixed in round 2, verify-b3-r2-B.md). Neither has failed before. What P202 built (`App/lib/screens/day_timeline_screen.dart`): the banners sit in a Column under the day header; «Sin hora» is pinned under them in a `ConstrainedBox(maxHeight: space.maxHeight / 3)` (about :278-280), where `space` is the height from the day header's bottom to the screen's bottom (the Scaffold has `extendBody: true`, about :212, and the body pads itself by `MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom`, about :236). Inside it: a `Scrollbar(thumbVisibility: true)` on its own `_untimed` controller, a `SingleChildScrollView` keyed `timeline-untimed` with 4 dp top padding, `SectionLabel(l.timelineUnblocked)`, the all-day event `ListTile`s, and for each `data.unblocked` task a `LandedTaskTile`/`TaskTile` with `showDate: true` (about :307-321). Review B accepted that structure, the scrollbar and the way the third is measured; keep all of it.

What failed (R2B-1, render `calendar/timeline.untimed.es.light.2x.png`): at 2× on 360×800 the area's only row, «Pagar la factura de la luz» (date-only, priority 2), is cut through its «Hoy · Prioridad Media» line, and the hours start right under the cut with no edge between them. The moment: «¿Se ha roto? La tarjeta de la factura se corta por la mitad.» «Hoy» repeats what the day header already says.

Do (subtract first): (a) In the pinned area only, pass `showDate: false` to both the `LandedTaskTile` and the `TaskTile` when the task's own date is the Día view's day (`task.displayDate` on the same day as `_day`, e.g. `Task.dateKey(task.displayDate!) == Task.dateKey(_day)`). Keep `showDate: true` for any other row: `DayTimeline` (`App/lib/models/day_timeline.dart:90-93`) also lists a task here for a date-only deadline on this day, and if that task's own date is another day, its row must keep naming that day. With `showDate: false`, `TaskTile._dateLine` (`App/lib/widgets/task_tile.dart:46-58`) gives no date line for a date-only task and only the clock time for a timed one; «Prioridad Media», the project, the person and the other details stay as they are. (b) Right under the pinned area, outside its `ConstrainedBox` and its scroll view, so it never scrolls, add a full-width `Divider(height: 1, thickness: 1, color: Theme.of(context).colorScheme.outlineVariant)`, the colour the hour lines already use (about :401). It shows only when the pinned area shows. A row cut at the area's edge then reads as an edge, not as a broken card. (c) If, after (a), the row's last line still ends below the area at es 2× on 360×800, don't change the cap, how it's measured, the rows' widgets or the fixture to force it: keep (a) and (b) and report the measured numbers in your notes; the next round decides.

No new strings, no ARB change. Tests: the UX-1633 tests in `App/test/day_timeline_test.dart` (about :440-600) build `dateOnly()` with priority 1, so its row has no details line; make the arrival test also run with priority 2, as the preview fixture (`App/test/ux_previews/support/fixtures.dart:167`) has, and update any assertion that expects «Hoy» on a «Sin hora» row. Re-render `calendar/timeline.untimed` and `calendar/timeline.normal`.

Don't touch: `App/lib/widgets/task_tile.dart`; every other `TaskTile`/`LandedTaskTile` (Agenda, Tareas, Completadas and the lists keep their date lines); the all-day event rows and their subtitle; the banners; the third cap and its measurement; the scrollbar; the 4 dp top padding and 8 dp gaps; `_landedRow`, `_reveal`, `_opening`, `_place` and pull-to-refresh; the timeline's drawing.
acceptance: ES, 2× text on 360×800, Día view of today at 09:41 with `normalDay()` plus the date-only «Pagar la factura de la luz» at priority 2 (`calendar/timeline.untimed`): on arrival the whole row, its title and its «Prioridad Media» line, lies inside the «Sin hora» area (`timeline-untimed`); the row shows no «Hoy»; and the 08:30 «Paseo por el parque» block is on screen.
ES, 1× text on 360×800, same state: «Sin hora», the whole «Pagar la factura de la luz» row without «Hoy», and the 08:30 block are on screen on arrival.

ES, 1× and 2× on 360×800, same state: a 1 dp horizontal line in outlineVariant spans the screen right under the «Sin hora» area, and the hours' scroll view (`timeline-scroll`) starts right below it; after the hours are scrolled to 20:00 the line is still in the same place.
ES, 1× and 2×, `calendar/timeline.normal` (nothing untimed): no «Sin hora» label and no line under the header's notices; the 08:30 block is on screen on arrival.
ES, 1×, Día view of today with a timed task due on another day whose date-only deadline is today: if it is listed under «Sin hora», its row still names its own day, as before.

ES, 2×, a day with five date-only tasks and a task at 08:30: the «Sin hora» area is still no taller than a third of the space from the day header's bottom to the screen's bottom, scrolls by itself, and the 08:30 task is on screen on arrival.
Saving a date-only task from the Día view still lights its row in the «Sin hora» area, on screen.
deviceChecks: Emulator lane at Android font size 2.0 on 393 dp: the Día view of today with one date-only task at priority Media shows «Sin hora», the whole row, a line under it, then the first timed task, on arrival.

packages.title: Re-check only: round 2's reminder, Completed, catalog and row fixes (no code change)
brief: Round 3 (b3). Not a fix. The workflow reported these seven findings as not checked after round 2, but review B's notes (`.claude/ux-review/runs/2026-10-19-app/verify-b3-r2-B.md`, the Results table) record every one as fixed, with code and render evidence: UX-1634 (P203), UX-1635 and UX-1636 (P204), UX-1414, UX-1421 and UX-1638 (P205), UX-1637 (P206). This package exists only so the reviewer's result reaches the record. It holds more than six findings because there's nothing to build.
Implementer: change nothing. Don't edit, format or re-generate any file. Report «no change: re-check only».

Reviewer: confirm each against its round 2 acceptance in `plan-b3-r2.json` (P203–P206) on the current tree, after P207. P207 changes only `day_timeline_screen.dart` and its test, and none of these findings live there. The Catalan of UX-1421 and of `reminderForPersonOnly` («Recordatori per a {name}») still wants a native read; that's a note, not a failure.
acceptance: ES 1×, `tasks/detail` created-by (a task given to Ana that follows the default): the reminder button reads «Recordatorio para Ana», with no «10 minutos antes»; with its own value it reads «Recordatorio para Ana: 30 minutos antes».
ES 1×, `calendar/completed.project-person`: under the title, «Matemáticas · Ana»; with «Para mí», «Matemáticas · Para mí»; with «Todas», «Matemáticas» alone.
ES 1× and 2×, `calendar/completed.project`: the rows don't show «Matemáticas»; `calendar/completed.list` still does on «Subir las notas».

`App/test/localization_catalog_test.dart` passes: “transfer” appears in EN only in `groupTransfer` and `archiveCsvPersonalCopies`; the seven UX-1421 keys hold P205's EN/ES/CA copy; `schedule` is in no catalog; “scheduling” is only in `retryScheduling`.
ES 2×, `tasks/detail.file-space-full`: «(100 MB).» on one line; `storageFull` holds U+00A0 before «MB» in EN, ES and CA.
ES 1×, `calendar/agenda.added` and `tasks/project.viewer`: a view-only row's title starts at the same x as the editable rows' titles (80 dp), with no icon in the circle's place.
